desc: Ideation and selection of the DP approach.
Implement positive-product DP keyed by (used, parity, product) -> bitmask of alternating sums, pruning product*x > limit, returning the max product p whose sum-mask contains k.
Implement zero-feasibility DP over ALL elements with state (parity, seen_zero) -> bitmask of alternating sums for non-empty zero-containing subsequences.
Combine: return positive best if >=1, else 0 if zero-feasible, else -1.
Run the three provided examples plus a randomized brute-force stress test against exhaustive subsequence enumeration (examples yield 6, -1, 9; no counterexamples found).
